full_description: default: pick up the raw meat from the cutting board, place it on the pan, press the red cook key to latch cooking on, press again to latch off at the target doneness; option 2: mirrored dual stations — both arms place both steaks and toggle each station's cook key (both steaks must be cooked properly). Meat may stay on the pan; no board return required
schema: {A} notifies the meat, {B} notifies the pan, {C} notifies the cutting board, {E} notifies the cook key, {n} notifies dual-station count when option 2 is on, {a} notifies the arm(s) that handle the meat, {o} notifies option 2 (dual setup) when active
preference: num of words should not exceed 20. Degree of detail avg is 6
